title: Repair Jose V12 pinned payload browser decode and rerun runtime gate
mission: Diagnose the exact response text/byte condition that makes the current Jose Study V12 LAB wrapper throw InvalidCharacterError in window.atob while reading the pinned V11 .html.gz.b64 source, then apply the smallest LAB-only source retrieval/base64 decoding correction and rerun real Chromium verification through the existing SHA-256 gate, topic-local map checks and V12/V11 A/B toggle. Do not rewrite the V11 source payload merely to make the wrapper pass. If payload corruption is proven, return a boundary with evidence instead.
Any implementation change remains inside the Jose LAB candidate and/or verification harness and is the smallest change that resolves the proven decoder incompatibility.
Real Chromium observes V11 SHA-256 PASS for digest 0cf9a40fb53e977dccb40c9755d668a3ee922ccd61883f19229bb4a113139a05 before candidate use.

The Algebra menu still exposes Index Laws, Factorization, Quadratics and Simultaneous Equations as distinct topics; at least one topic-local map records 12 levels and 3 rounds and does not flatten all topics into one rail.
Exercise the V12/V11 A/B toggle and confirm intact V11 rendering remains available and V12 can be restored.
Persist real-browser evidence and do not modify Catalog, Current, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served pointers.
